sources.label: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery Capes (Pet Simulator 99)

notes: Current source check confirmed 14 mastery skills. The Master Skill Cape is an all-masteries reward and is not counted as a mastery row.
Row fields summarize stable XP sources, player use, notable perk themes, and level 99 rewards. Full per-level perk arrays and exact grind formulas are intentionally omitted from default cards.
Images are intentionally blank until clean row-specific mastery or cape assets are gathered locally.

items.name: Breakables Mastery
items.bestFor: Long farming sessions and loot grinding
items.notablePerks: Better loot, faster respawns, longer flags, and mini-chest bonuses
items.level99: +100% respawn speed, +21 flag slots, +50% mini-chest spawn chance, 2x flag duration, 5x mini-chest loot, plus Breakables Mastery Cape
items.grindStyle: Natural AFK or active farming grind
items.shortcutNote: Usually worth leveling through normal farming unless you need the final loot perks quickly.
items.description: Breakables Mastery rewards the core PS99 loop of smashing objects for coins, diamonds, and drops. It is one of the easiest masteries to progress while you are already farming.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 6
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Launch mastery from Update 6. Card summarizes stable perk themes instead of full per-level table.

items.name: Eggs Mastery
items.bestFor: Players who hatch constantly or chase pet variants
items.notablePerks: Cheaper eggs, faster hatch animation, bonus egg slots, and golden/rainbow hatch chances
items.level99: +5 bonus egg slots, 30% cheaper eggs, and Eggs Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: A strong shortcut target for hatch-focused players because normal eggs give very slow progress.
items.description: Eggs Mastery is built for players who spend long sessions hatching. Its best perks reduce hatch friction and make large hatch sessions cheaper and faster.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 6
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Exclusive and normal egg XP differ in source table, but default card avoids exact 1-to-99 formulas.

items.name: Pets Mastery
items.xpSource: Use the Gold Machine, Rainbow Machine, Fuse Machine, or Daycare
items.bestFor: Players converting, fusing, or enrolling large pet stacks
items.notablePerks: Faster machines, better gold/rainbow chances, lower pet requirements, and better Daycare rewards
items.level99: -2 pets required for golding and rainbowing, 2x Daycare speed and diamond loot, plus Pets Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Useful for players who hate pet conversion chores, but fusing can also train it over time.
items.description: Pets Mastery improves the systems that turn pet stacks into stronger or more useful pets. It overlaps with Fuse Mastery because fusing pets can train both tracks.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 7
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Update 7 introduced Pets Mastery; source table states fusing can level both Pets and Fuse Mastery.

items.name: Potions Mastery
items.xpSource: Consume potions or upgrade potions at the Upgrade Potions Machine
items.bestFor: Players who use boost timers and craft higher potion tiers
items.notablePerks: Longer potion duration, cheaper upgrades, higher tier access, auto-claiming, and multi-type upgrading
items.level99: 2x potion duration, upgrade multiple potion types at once, plus Potions Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Good shortcut value if you use high-tier potions often and want the duration or upgrade perks.
items.description: Potions Mastery makes timed boosts easier to use and upgrade. It is strongest for players who regularly farm with potion timers active.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 6
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Potion XP source and level 99 perks verified; exact upgrade formulas are not used in the card.

items.name: Enchants Mastery
items.xpSource: Upgrade enchants at the Upgrade Enchants Machine
items.notablePerks: Cheaper upgrades, higher tier equip/craft access, stronger enchant power, and multi-type upgrading
items.level99: 25% power from enchants, upgrade multiple enchant types at once, plus Enchants Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Strong for loadout-focused players because tier access and enchant power affect many farming setups.
items.description: Enchants Mastery supports book upgrades and stronger loadouts. It matters most once your farming setup depends on higher-tier enchant books.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 6
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Enchant XP source and level 99 perks verified; exact book counts are omitted from default card.

items.name: Fruits Mastery
items.xpSource: Consume fruit or craft rainbow and shiny fruit
items.bestFor: Players who keep fruit buffs active
items.notablePerks: Longer fruit duration, cheaper rainbow fruit crafting, larger queues, and automatic fruit use
items.level99: Auto-eat normal and shiny fruit, reduced rainbow crafting cost, 30-fruit buff cap, plus Fruit Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Better as a shortcut target if you actively use fruit buffs; casual players can train it gradually.
items.description: Fruits Mastery turns fruit from a small consumable habit into a stronger passive buff system. Its late perks are mostly about longer buffs and less manual eating.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 7
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Update 7 introduced Fruit Mastery. Row uses normalized plural name for catalog consistency.

items.name: Economy Mastery
items.xpSource: Purchase items from vending machines and merchants
items.bestFor: Players who use vending machines and merchants for items
items.notablePerks: Buy-all vending option, lower prices, faster restocks, more vending stock, and better merchant luck
items.level99: -50% merchant prices, automatic coin vending purchases, free coin vending items, plus Economy Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Usually easy to train if you run merchant and vending routes often.
items.description: Economy Mastery improves the value of shops and vending machines. It is a practical grind for players who already sweep the map for items.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 6
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Launch mastery from Update 6. Card keeps XP table hidden and focuses on stable shop benefits.

items.name: Keys Mastery
items.xpSource: Use keys and combine key halves
items.bestFor: Players opening key chests or managing key stacks
items.notablePerks: Chance to keep keys, better chest loot, combine-all keys, and free key chances while combining
items.level99: +25% loot from Fantasy, Crystal, Tech, and Void Chests, 2x free-key chances when combining, plus Keys Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Use shortcuts only if key opening is a major part of your routine or you dislike saving key stacks.
items.description: Keys Mastery is for players who open key chests and combine key pieces. Its value depends on how often you actually use key-based reward routes.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 8
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Update 8 introduced Keys Mastery. Card summarizes key retention, chest loot, and free-key combining instead of listing every milestone.

items.name: Superior Chests Mastery
items.bestFor: Players farming Superior Mini Chest spawns and loot
items.notablePerks: Higher Superior Chest spawn chance and multiplied Superior Chest loot
items.level99: +50% Superior Chest spawn chance, 5x Superior Chest loot, plus Superior Chests Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: A focused shortcut target only if Superior Chest farming is part of your setup.
items.description: Superior Chests Mastery is narrow but useful for players built around mini-chest spawns. It improves both how often the chests appear and how much they pay out.
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Source table has section-level perks around spawn chance and loot multipliers; card summarizes instead of listing every milestone.

items.name: Gifts Mastery
items.xpSource: Open bundles, mini chest items, gift boxes, charm stones, or claim free gifts
items.bestFor: Players opening reward items and collecting free gifts
items.notablePerks: Double-loot chances, faster Free Gift timers, better Charm Stone loot, and auto-claiming
items.level99: Faster Free Gifts, better Charm Stone loot, stronger double-loot chances, plus Gifts Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Useful if you open many saved gifts; otherwise it can grow slowly through normal rewards.
items.description: Gifts Mastery improves the reward items that pile up during normal play. It is especially useful when you open bundles, mini chests, and free gifts in bulk.
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: XP source includes several gift-like item categories; default card keeps full XP table hidden.

items.name: Boost Exchange Mastery
items.xpSource: Use the Boost Exchange machine and spend Millionaire Bucks on boosts
items.bestFor: Players who regularly buy boost effects
items.notablePerks: Cheaper boosts, stronger boosts, longer boost duration, and automatic boost buying
items.level99: Boosts are 40% more effective plus Boost Exchange Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Only prioritize if Boost Exchange is already part of your farming routine.
items.description: Boost Exchange Mastery is tied to buying temporary boost effects with Millionaire Bucks. It is strongest for players who plan farming sessions around those boosts.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 32
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Update 32 introduced Boost Exchange Mastery with Fuse Mastery.

items.name: Fishing Mastery
items.xpSource: Fish in the Fishing or Advanced Fishing minigames
items.bestFor: Players chasing Deep Pool rewards and fishing Huge chances
items.notablePerks: Faster casting and catching, Deep Pool access, better Deep Pool Huge chance, larger bobber, and rainbow rod chance
items.level99: +50% chance to catch a Huge from Deep Pools, 2x rainbow rod conversion chance, plus Fishing Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Good shortcut candidate if you dislike fishing but want Deep Pool perks.
items.description: Fishing Mastery is a focused minigame track. It does not train from every fishing-like activity, so the source minigames matter.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 7
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Source states Fishing World catches do not affect this mastery; row keeps that context in description.

items.name: Digging Mastery
items.xpSource: Dig in the Digsite-style minigame route
items.bestFor: Players who farm digging rewards and minigame Huge chances
items.notablePerks: Better Digsite chest drops, more diamonds, better chest find odds, Mastery Chest access, Huge chance, and rainbow shovel chance
items.level99: +35% Digsite chest diamonds, +50% drops, +50% Mastery Chest Huge chance, 2x rainbow shovel chance, plus Digging Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: A shortcut makes sense only if you want digging rewards but do not enjoy the minigame loop.
items.description: Digging Mastery is another focused minigame track. It is most useful when you spend real time in the digging loop instead of only passing through it.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 8
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Update 8 introduced Digging Mastery. Card avoids exact fastest-grind formulas.

items.name: Fuse Mastery
items.xpSource: Fuse pets in the Fuse Machine
items.bestFor: Players turning pet stacks into better results
items.notablePerks: Chance for two pets, better fuse results, faster animation, guaranteed gold/rainbow results at high levels
items.level99: 5% chance to get two pets and minimum fuse lowered to 2 pets, plus Fuse Mastery Cape
items.shortcutNote: Fusing also trains Pets Mastery, so active fusers may not need to spend a shortcut here first.
items.description: Fuse Mastery improves the Fuse Machine itself. It rewards players who regularly turn extra pets into stronger results.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki - Mastery (Pet Simulator 99); BIG Games Update 32
items.sourceStatus: count and perk themes verified from current public source pages
items.verificationNote: Update 32 introduced Fuse Mastery; source says fusing levels both Fuse and Pets Mastery.
